title: Maximum Sum of Almost Unique Subarray
summary: Given an integer array and two positive integers m and k, find the maximum sum of any subarray of length k that contains at least m distinct elements.
statement: Given an integer array and two positive integers m and k, find the maximum sum of any subarray of length k that contains at least m distinct elements. If no such subarray exists, return 0.
constraints: nums is nonempty and 1 <= m <= k <= len(nums).
Consider exactly length-k contiguous windows having at least m distinct values.
Return the largest qualifying sum, or zero if no window qualifies.
hints: A fixed-width window needs both its sum and distinct-value count.
Maintain a frequency map and running sum as one value enters and one leaves.
Delete zero-frequency keys, test distinct_count>=m, and update the maximum qualifying sum.
Each length-k window is visited once with exact frequency and sum state, so taking the maximum over qualifying states is exhaustive.
editorial: Each length-k window is visited once with exact frequency and sum state, so taking the maximum over qualifying states is exhaustive.

tests.explanation: The qualifying first window [2,6,7,3] has the maximum sum eighteen.
Every window qualifies, and [5,9,9] has maximum sum twenty-three.
